selection: Pooled inner accuracy, then five-class macro-F1, then smaller C
hypothesis: Distribution and adjacent-bin dynamics may contain useful information absent from mean/std summaries. Test richer features against matched mean/std controls with the same fixed fold-local ANOVA top-20 selector and regularized logistic model.
feature_policy: Label-free per-participant summaries of existing observed 0.5-second bins. Adjacent changes/correlations use only consecutive valid bins within each modality, never bridge missing bins or pair modalities. Constant or unsupported lag statistics are zero with support recorded separately; support is not a predictor.
selection_policy: StandardScaler and ANOVA selector fit within each inner/outer fitting fold. Select up to 20 nonconstant columns; exact ANOVA ties favor earlier schema order. No gender, participant IDs, interview lengths or quality counts as predictors.
limits: Post-final exploratory training-only comparison. All 275 participants and 281 sources remain covered; fit/score only the 163 official training participants. Retain the original crop and unresolved speaker/timing limitations. No validation/test scoring, new full-training model, or frozen-reference replacement. Do not expand the search based on these outer scores.
